item.title: Travel Directory Website Growth & Monetization Specialist – SEO, Research, Scraping & Business Development
item.description:
250-750 USD | # Job Title: Travel Directory Website Growth & Monetization Specialist – SEO, Research, Scraping & Business Development
## Job Overview
We are looking for a results-driven individual or small team to help build and grow a travel directory and deals website inspired by TripAdvisor and other successful travel platforms.
The goal is to create a website where travelers can discover hotels, tours, attractions, activities, restaurants, transportation, travel deals, and local experiences.
The website should generate revenue through affiliate commissions, sponsored listings, featured placements, advertising, and paid business subscriptions.
We are looking for someone who can do more than build a website. You must be able to research the market, collect and organize travel business information, create SEO-friendly content, attract traffic, and approach businesses to generate paying customers.
**The initial focus will be on Israel tourism and activities, with the opportunity to expand into additional destinations.**
## Scope of Work
### 1. Website Development & Setup - Help plan and develop a professional, mobile-friendly travel directory website. - Build a homepage with destination search, categories, featured deals, and recommended activities. - Create individual pages for hotels, attractions, tour operators, activities, restaurants, and travel services. - Add search and filtering by destination, category, price, and activity type. - Include business submission and claim-your-listing functionality. - Create options for free, premium, and sponsored business listings. - Integrate booking and affiliate links to established travel platforms. - Ensure the website is designed for SEO, speed, and future expansion.
### 2. Competitor Research & Data Collection - Research successful travel websites, directories, and competitors. - Identify their traffic sources, SEO strategies, categories, and monetization methods. - Scrape or collect publicly available information about hotels, tour operators, attractions, and activities, while respecting website terms and applicable privacy laws. - Identify business names, websites, contact information, locations, descriptions, and relevant services. - Organize collected information into a structured database. - Identify businesses that could benefit from additional exposure and leads.
### 3. SEO & Organic Traffic Growth - Conduct keyword research and identify high-traffic, low-competition opportunities. - Build SEO-friendly destination, category, attraction, and business pages. - Create original, useful content targeting travelers searching for things to do and places to visit. - Optimize page titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, images, and structured data. - Build quality backlinks through relevant travel websites, blogs, partnerships, and outreach. - Set up Google Analytics and Google Search Console. - Develop a strategy to rank individual destination and activity pages on Google. - Monitor rankings, organic traffic, and conversions.
We are interested in sustainable, white-hat SEO—not spam backlinks or automated mass-produced pages.
### 4. Affiliate Marketing & Revenue Generation Research, apply for, and integrate relevant affiliate programs, including:
- Tripadvisor - Viator - GetYourGuide - Booking.com - Expedia - Hotels.com - Other relevant hotel, flight, tour, and travel providers.
Responsibilities: - Add affiliate links to relevant hotel, tour, and attraction pages. - Create destination guides and travel deal pages that encourage bookings. - Track clicks, referrals, and conversions. - Identify opportunities for exclusive travel deals and promotions. - Recommend additional affiliate partners and revenue opportunities.
### 5. Business Outreach & Customer Acquisition This is a major part of the position.
You will be responsible for finding businesses that could become paying customers of the directory.
Tasks include: - Scrape and research travel businesses and build prospect lists. - Find business owners, managers, and marketing contacts. - Contact businesses through cold calling, email, LinkedIn, and other methods. - Explain the benefits of being listed on our platform. - Offer premium listings, featured placements, sponsored articles, and advertising. - Book qualified meetings with interested business owners. - Follow up with prospects until they become paying customers. - Maintain a CRM with contact history, meeting status, and sales results.
### 6. Monetization Products to Sell
The website will offer several revenue opportunities:
- Free basic business listing. - Premium business listing. - Featured placement in destination and category pages. - Sponsored articles and travel guides. - Featured deals and promotions. - Monthly advertising packages. - Exclusive offers and promotional campaigns. - Qualified customer leads for tour operators and travel businesses.
You should help recommend pricing and packages that businesses will be willing to purchase.
### 7. Email Marketing & Automation - Build an email subscriber list. - Create weekly travel deals and destination newsletters. - Set up automated email follow-ups. - Create lead capture forms. - Use GoHighLevel (GHL) or a comparable CRM to manage business prospects, meetings, and customer follow-ups. - Develop a system to encourage repeat visits and bookings.
## Required Experience
We are looking for someone with experience in several of the following areas:
- WordPress website development. - Travel directories, listing websites, or marketplace platforms. - SEO and organic traffic growth. - Web scraping and data research. - Affiliate marketing. - Google rankings and backlink building. - Lead generation and cold outreach. - Appointment setting and business development. - Email marketing and CRM automation. - GoHighLevel experience is a plus.
You do not need to be an expert in every area, but you must be able to take ownership of the project and deliver measurable results.
## Compensation – Performance-Based
We are interested in a results-driven compensation structure rather than simply paying for hours worked.
Compensation can be structured around:
1. **Website milestones:** Payment for agreed development and setup deliverables. 2. **Qualified meetings:** Payment for qualified business meetings that are successfully booked and attended. 3. **New paying customers:** Additional compensation for each business that purchases a listing, advertising package, or subscription. 4. **Recurring revenue:** Potential ongoing commission on customers acquired and retained. 5. **Growth bonuses:** Additional incentives for achieving agreed traffic, lead generation, and revenue targets.
Specific rates and performance targets will be agreed upon before work begins.
We are looking for someone interested in growing this into a long-term business opportunity.
## First 30-Day Objectives
The initial project will focus on:
- Complete competitor and market research. - Recommend the best website platform and directory structure. - Identify the most profitable travel categories and keywords. - Build the initial website structure. - Collect and organize an initial database of travel businesses. - Publish the first batch of useful destination and activity pages. - Identify and apply for relevant affiliate programs. - Begin contacting travel businesses. - Book the first qualified business meetings. - Present a clear plan for traffic growth and monetization.
## How to Apply
Please answer the following questions:
1. Have you built a travel directory, deals website, or marketplace before? Please provide examples. 2. What platform would you recommend for this project and why? 3. What experience do you have with SEO and ranking websites on Google? 4. Can you scrape and organize business information from multiple websites? 5. How would you find travel businesses and convert them into paying advertisers? 6. Have you worked with Tripadvisor, Viator, GetYourGuide, Booking.com, or other affiliate programs? 7. Are you comfortable with cold calling, email outreach, and booking meetings? 8. Have you used GoHighLevel or another CRM? 9. How would you structure compensation based on measurable results?
**Please include examples of websites you have worked on, SEO results, traffic growth, lead generation results, and businesses you have acquired as customers.**
We want someone entrepreneurial who can help turn this concept into a real, revenue-generating travel platform—not just someone who builds a website and walks away.

item.title: GoHighLevel Real Estate Systems Architect
item.description:
30-250 CAD | GoHighLevel (GHL) Systems Architect – Full Account Audit, Multi-Segment Setup & Automation
Project Overview
I am looking for an experienced GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM, Automation & Systems Architect to audit, organize, and fully build out my existing GHL account. I run a solo real estate business that spans multiple segments (Residential Buyers/Sellers, Leasing, Commercial Real Estate, and Business Brokerage). I am not looking for a basic landing page builder. I need someone who understands CRM strategy + data segmentation + advanced deliverability, who can clean up my existing assets while implementing a precise technical blueprint I have already mapped out.
What I Have Already
• An active GHL account and custom website with multiple features. • Existing leads, contacts, and past client databases (needs cleaning/segmenting). • Scraped lists and business registries ready for outbound prospecting. • Scattershot funnels and automations that need to be audited, improved, or replaced.
Scope of Work & Technical Blueprint
Phase 1: Audit, Cleanup & Data Segmentation
• System Audit: Review all existing workflows, forms, and triggers. Delete or archive broken or redundant automations to clean up the account. • Master Sub-Account Structure: Organize all data within one single master sub-account (no fragmented sub-accounts). • Contact Cleansing: Clean, deduplicate, and segment my existing contact database using specific master tags (Segment: Buyer, Segment: Seller, Segment: Commercial, etc.).
Phase 2: Core Architecture & 6 Custom Pipelines
You will build and configure 6 distinct Kanban pipelines with unique milestone stages tailored to each asset class: 1. Residential Buyers 2. Residential Sellers 3. Residential Leasing (Application, background check, lease stages) 4. Commercial Real Estate (Buyers/Sellers) (NDA, LOI, due diligence stages) 5. Business For Sale (Valuation, CIM prep, marketing stages) 6. Outbound Prospecting Pipeline (A dedicated "buffer" pipeline to filter raw/scraped cold leads before they hit my main business metrics)
Phase 3: Outbound Isolation & Deliverability Configuration
• Domain Isolation: Integrate a secondary "lookalike" cold email domain specifically for outbound prospecting to protect my main website domain’s sender reputation. Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. • Outbound Phone Setup: Configure a secondary GHL tracking line with A2P 10DLC parameters strictly for manual outbound sprints.
Phase 4: Workflow Automations & Handraiser Controls
• The Inbound Reply Stop: Build an automated trigger where any reply to a cold outbound campaign instantly pauses the automation, moves the contact to Handraiser / Reply Received in the Prospecting Pipeline, and shoots an Instant Push Notification to my phone via the LeadConnector app (linking directly to the conversation). • Mobile Call-Logging Triggers: Build workflows mapped to 4 custom tags (Call: Left Voicemail, Call: No Answer, Call: Callback Requested, Call: Gatekeeper Block). When I apply these tags in the GHL mobile power-dialer, GHL must automatically update the opportunity stage and schedule the next follow-up task.
Phase 5: Nurturing, Reporting & Training
• Re-engagement Campaigns: Set up automated past-client, referral, and database re-engagement campaigns. • Attribution Reporting: Configure dashboard widgets so I can filter conversion rates and pipeline values by individual business segments. • Hand-off & Training: Provide a live walkthrough or short recorded training session showing me exactly how to navigate the new, cleaned system.
Proposed Project Milestones (Escrow Release)
Payment will be split into three strict milestones based on deliverables: • Milestone 1 (20%): Completion of the GHL account audit, database cleanup, domain isolation setup, and tag restructuring. • Milestone 2 (50%): Successful build of all 6 pipelines, conditional custom fields, cold outreach workflows, and mobile app call-logging automations (Fully Tested). • Milestone 3 (30%): Re-engagement campaigns live, dashboard reporting verified, and final training/hand-off completed.
Submission Requirements (Proposals ignoring this will be archived)
To be considered, your proposal MUST include: 1. Fixed-Price Quote: Provide the total, all-inclusive price for the complete project based on the scope above. No placeholder bids. 2. Timeline: How many days will this take you from start to finish? 3. Work Samples: Provide screenshots or a short video of a GHL architecture, pipeline system, or multi-channel workflow you have personally built (real estate focus is a massive plus). 4. Screening Question: Answer this in your application: “How do you prevent a cold lead from continuing to receive automated emails once they manually reply to a GHL workflow?” (This proves you read the description.)

**Project Type:** Fixed Price **Budget:** $750–$1,500 USD **Website:** https://www.ixilusa.com **Preferred Theme:** BigCommerce Cornerstone Light (Stencil) **Timeline:** Approximately 2–4 weeks
## Project Overview
We are seeking an experienced BigCommerce developer to migrate our established motorcycle exhaust e-commerce website from the legacy **BigCommerce Default v6.6 (Blueprint) theme** to a modern Stencil theme.
We want to preserve our existing website's appearance, branding, navigation, products, and functionality while improving mobile responsiveness, performance, and compatibility.
**This is a theme migration, NOT a complete redesign or platform change.**
## 1. Theme Migration and Design
- Use the free BigCommerce Cornerstone Light theme or recommend a suitable alternative. - Preserve our existing logo, colors, branding, homepage, banners, menus, and general appearance. - Maintain product and category layouts as closely as practical. - Improve performance and compatibility. - Deliver a fully responsive website for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
**Mobile optimization is essential**, including navigation, product pages, fitment searches, cart, and checkout.
## 2. Motorcycle Fitment Selector – Search Magic
Our existing "Select Your Ride" motorcycle make/model/year selector is powered by the BigCommerce **Search Magic app ($49/month)**.
- Preserve the existing app and all fitment data. - Integrate it correctly with the new Stencil theme. - Ensure accurate motorcycle make/model/year searches. - Test full functionality on desktop and mobile.
This is an existing third-party app. We are NOT requesting a new fitment system.
## 3. CRITICAL – Google SEO and URL Preservation
**Protecting our existing Google rankings and indexed pages is a top priority.**
The developer MUST:
- Preserve ALL existing product, category, and informational page URLs exactly as they currently exist. - Preserve SEO titles, meta descriptions, canonical tags, structured data, and existing 301 redirects. - Maintain internal links, Google Search Console verification, analytics, and sitemap functionality. - Prevent broken links, duplicate pages, and accidental indexing restrictions. - Document and audit existing URLs before migration and verify them after launch. - Obtain written approval before changing ANY existing URL. - Implement proper 301 redirects if an approved URL change is unavoidable.
The migration must follow SEO best practices to minimize any risk to our established Google traffic. SEO verification must be included in the fixed price.
## 4. Customer Accounts, Checkout, and Integrations
Our current legacy theme has a customer registration issue involving reCAPTCHA.
Requirements:
- Fix customer registration and ensure BigCommerce-supported CAPTCHA protection works correctly. - Preserve existing customer accounts and order history. - Verify customer login and account management. - Preserve and test PayPal and BigCommerce checkout. - Confirm compatibility with our existing ShipStation integration. - Test the complete purchase process on desktop and mobile.
## 5. Development, Testing, and Launch
- Develop using an unpublished theme or separate development environment. - Keep our existing live website operational throughout development. - Provide a working preview for approval. - Test navigation, Search Magic, customer accounts, checkout, mobile functionality, and SEO. - Back up the existing theme and establish a rollback plan. - Launch ONLY after receiving our written approval.
## 6. Ownership and Post-Launch Support
- Deliver all completed custom theme files and newly developed code. - Transfer ownership of newly created custom work to IXIL USA upon final payment, excluding third-party licensed components. - Disclose any additional software or licensing costs before proceeding. - Include **14 days of post-launch support** to correct migration-related issues involving SEO, links, Search Magic, checkout, customer accounts, or mobile functionality.
## 7. Developer Qualifications and Bidding Requirements
We require demonstrated experience with **BigCommerce Stencil development**, preferably including legacy Blueprint-to-Stencil migrations.
Please include in your proposal:
1. Examples of BigCommerce websites you have developed or migrated. 2. Your experience migrating Blueprint themes to Stencil. 3. Whether you recommend Cornerstone Light or another theme. 4. Confirmation you can preserve existing URLs, SEO, and Search Magic functionality. 5. Your approach to fixing the customer registration/reCAPTCHA issue. 6. Your complete fixed-price quote and estimated completion time. 7. Confirmation that 14 days of post-launch support are included.
**Please review https://www.ixilusa.com before bidding. Generic proposals without relevant BigCommerce experience will not be considered.**
## Final Priorities
Our priorities are preserving existing Google visibility and URLs, maintaining our IXIL USA branding, upgrading desktop/mobile functionality, keeping Search Magic operational, and ensuring a smooth migration without disrupting our business.
**Fixed Budget: $750–$1,500 USD.**
We are looking for a reliable BigCommerce specialist who can complete the migration correctly and potentially assist with future website improvements.

**The main problem**
The demo and live versions were intended to use the same adaptive strategy, with the additional account permissions needed for live trading. In practice, their behaviour and results have differed.
The live bot has sometimes opened and closed trades within seconds, including taking very small profits or losses. Logs show that some of these exits came from the model deciding its expected edge had faded or reversed, rather than the trailing stop being hit. That change was subsequently removed, and the latest live candidate’s decision engine was matched to the demo engine and checked with replay tests. - Other repairs have addressed quote changes during saving that cancelled entry attempts, a delayed trade-closure/checkpoint issue, and position ownership problems caused by shared labels between bot copies. - Local learning restoration has been implemented and observed working through restarts of the same instance. - The cloud demo’s model is currently held in memory for that run. Check candle timing, tick updates, bid/ask prices, spread, commissions, slippage and execution delays. 4. Establish a reliable model-only export/import process where supported. Keep account-specific positions, orders and ownership records separate. 5. Verify restart recovery, duplicate-order prevention and isolation between multiple instances. 6. Preserve the intended stop-loss, trailing-stop and sizing behaviour. Any strategy changes should be clearly explained and tested against the baseline. 7. Reconcile results using this bot’s confirmed trades and net results after costs, separately from manual trades and unrelated account history.
**Deliverables**

item.description: 250-750 USD | Free Moving Marketplace — Website Development Project Project Overview We are seeking an experienced Bubble developer to build Free Moving Marketplace, a customer-facing moving-services marketplace initially serving the San Francisco Bay Area. We are a marketplace, not a moving company. Customers will submit moving information, receive manually prepared guaranteed price quotes, and either book at that price or participate in a moving-date auction. The website should be professional, mobile-friendly, easy to navigate, and built primarily using Bubble's existing functionality. We want a straightforward, cost-effective implementation with minimal custom development. Most administrative operations will be handled manually. Customer Accounts and Moving Inventory Customers can register, log in, and access their own moving information. Customers enter their moving date, pickup address, and delivery address. Customers can upload multiple furniture photos, upload written inventory lists, or manually select furniture and quantities from our predefined furniture catalog. We will provide the master furniture catalog, including item descriptions and cubic-foot values. The catalog must remain editable within Bubble. All customer submissions must be stored in Bubble's database and accessible to us through its built-in administrative tools. We will manually review inventories, calculate cubic footage and mileage, and determine guaranteed moving prices outside the website. We will enter the guaranteed price into Bubble and communicate it to the customer. Customers can accept their guaranteed price or enter the auction. Simplified Moving-Date Auctions We will operate one auction per moving date, with one winning customer per date. Customers click "Enter Auction" and submit a dollar bid through a simple website form. Each bid must be associated with the customer's account, moving date, and guaranteed price quote. Bid information will be recorded in Google Sheets for manual auction management. Customers compete only against others with the same moving date. We will manually calculate scores, manage rankings, close auctions, and select winners. Auction scoring formula: Score = (Customer Bid ÷ Customer Guaranteed Quote × 100) + Approved Social Media Tokens Customers are ranked by their scores, not simply by their dollar bids. Each approved social media post adds one token, equivalent to one additional score point. The website must display a simple leaderboard for each moving date showing anonymous bidder IDs, rankings, and scores. We will manage leaderboard data in Google Sheets. The website should display the leaderboard and reflect our spreadsheet updates. Customers can click "View Auction Rankings" to see their moving date's leaderboard. No automated scoring, live bidding engine, or automatic winner-selection system is required. We will manually announce the winner. The winning customer pays their winning dollar bid amount, not their guaranteed quote. They have 24 hours after the auction closes to submit payment. We will arrange moving-company fulfillment separately, outside the website. Referral and Social Media Tokens We will use Google Forms and Google Sheets to manage the referral program. Each auction participant receives a unique referral link or code to share with friends and family. Customers and their friends or family can submit links to qualifying social media posts through a Google Form. Friends and family do not need website accounts. Submissions are collected in Google Sheets. We manually review and approve social media posts. Each approved post earns one token, adding one point to the customer's auction score. We manually update token totals and auction rankings in our Google Sheets leaderboard. The website should provide customers with their referral link or code and straightforward access to the referral submission form. No custom referral-management system or automatic token approval is required. Bubble Database and Administration We want to use Bubble's existing database editor and administrative functionality rather than build a custom admin dashboard. Bubble must support: Customer accounts and login. Moving dates and pickup/delivery addresses. Furniture selections, quantities, uploaded photos, and inventory lists. Viewing and managing customer submissions. Manual entry and updating of guaranteed price quotes. Customer bids and auction information. Basic customer records and booking/payment statuses. Google Sheets will handle auction scoring, rankings, and referral tokens. Google Forms will collect social media post submissions. Stripe will handle payments. We will manually manage quotes, referral approvals, auctions, winners, payment verification, and booking confirmations. No custom administrative dashboard or reporting system is required. Any additional administrative functionality must be approved in advance. Payments and Bookings When a customer accepts their guaranteed quote, we manually send a Stripe payment link for the quoted amount. Auction winners receive a manually issued Stripe payment link for their winning bid amount, with payment due within 24 hours of auction closing. We manually email customers payment instructions and booking confirmations. We manually verify payments through Stripe and update booking/payment statuses in Bubble. Bubble only needs to store customer quotes, booking details, and payment/booking statuses. No custom Stripe integration, saved payment cards, automatic charging, or automated payment workflows are required. Customer-Facing Information Customers must be able to access the following information on the website: Their submitted moving details, inventory, and guaranteed price quote. Their submitted auction bid and moving date. Their moving-date auction leaderboard. Their booking status, such as pending or confirmed. Their referral link or code and access to the social media submission form. This information can appear on basic account pages, a simple dashboard, or other appropriate website pages. We do not require a dedicated custom dashboard. Please use whichever Bubble implementation is simplest and most cost-effective. Website Design and Technical Requirements Build the website using Bubble, within our own Bubble account. Responsive, professional design for desktop and mobile. Simple navigation and customer-friendly forms. Use Bubble's native functionality wherever practical. Google Forms and Google Sheets will support referrals and auction administration. No AI recognition, automated pricing engine, or Google Maps API integration is required. Avoid unnecessary custom code, plugins, and external services. Ownership, Accounts, Plugins, and Documentation Full ownership and independent maintainability are essential requirements. All development must take place within our Bubble account, which we create, own, and control. We will provide individually revocable developer access. We will not transfer ownership or share master login credentials. All third-party accounts, integrations, subscriptions, API credentials, and licenses must be registered under our ownership and control.
